notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: Hybrid conv/attention MoE: only 6 of 24 layers are full_attention, the other 18 are short-convolution layers that hold no KV cache at all. config.json (lfm2_moe): num_hidden_layers 24, layer_types = 18 conv + 6 full_attention, num_attention_heads 32, num_key_value_heads 8, no head_dim key so head_dim = hidden_size 2048 / 32 = 64, num_experts 32 with num_experts_per_tok 4, max_position_embeddings 128,000. 2 (K+V) x 6 attention layers x 8 KV heads x 64 head_dim x 2 bytes (bf16) = 12,288 B/token. MoE width does not affect KV cost -- only the 6 attention layers do. REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms the rest; 2 row(s) corrected to the card value. Card supports IFEval/IFBench/Multi-IF/MATH500/AIME25/Tau2 rows; BFCLv3 and BFCLv4 record values differ from card (64.79, 49.73). CORRECTED BACK 2026-10-22: an earlier pass changed BFCLv3/v4 to 64.79/49.73 from the card's comparison table, which broke consistency with the rest of the record and failed verify-scores. The card prints both; the ablation table is the one this record follows.
